content.short: Lace is a user-friendly, non-custodial wallet that brings together digital assets and dApps on Cardano.
content.description: Lace is a feature-rich, non-custodial web wallet developed by Input Output Global (IOG) to provide a direct gateway to the Cardano and Midnight ecosystems. It allows users to manage digital assets, stake ADA, and interact with a variety of decentralized applications (dApps) through an integrated DApp Store. With a focus on security and ease of use, Lace features built-in learning tools to support users at every stage of their Web3 journey. From asset management to digital identity solutions, Lace is designed to be an evolving platform that simplifies the blockchain experience for everyone.
